description: This Java source file defines the SeoCatalogUrlServlet class, a servlet handling SEO-friendly URL routing for product and category pages within an e-commerce application. It processes URL paths to identify product and category IDs, sets request attributes, and forwards requests to appropriate views. It also provides static methods to generate SEO URLs based on product and category IDs.

classes.name: SeoCatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that handles SEO-friendly URL routing for product and category pages, parsing URL paths to identify product and category IDs, setting request attributes, and forwarding to appropriate views.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for processing.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, extracts product and category IDs from URL path, sets request attributes, and forwards to the appropriate JSP page.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Generates an SEO-friendly URL for a product or category based on current and previous category IDs.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Generates an SEO URL string given a context path, breadcrumb trail, product ID, current category ID, and previous category ID.
